title: Identification and external validation of the sets of 4-, 6-, 8-, 12-, and 24-hour CGM motifs
abstract: arXiv:2611.18844v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: There is growing interest in using CGM for purposes other than those initially intended. Recent work of Lobo et al. identified $\Omega$: a set of motifs such that almost any daily CGM profile (the 24-hour CGM time series starting at midnight) can be classified - matched to a motif in $\Omega$. This work generalizes the prior work by identifying sets of motifs for 4-, 6-, 8-, 12-, and 24-hr CGM profiles where an $x$-hr CGM profile does not have to be 24 hours in length, and does not have to start at midnight. The prior work methods are modified to identify the five new sets of motifs using data from the same 6 studies in the original work. The newly identified sets were subjected to rigorous external validation using a data set comprised of data from 21 studies (3,455 subjects, 289,592 days of CGM data). translated_title: 4小时、6小时、8小时、12小时和24小时CGM（持续血糖监测）模式集的识别与外部验证
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.18844v1 公告类型：新 摘要：人们对于将CGM（持续血糖监测）用于其最初设计目的之外的用途越来越感兴趣。Lobo等人最近的工作识别出了集合 $\Omega$：一组模式，使得几乎任何每日CGM曲线（从午夜开始的24小时CGM时间序列）都可以被分类——即匹配到 $\Omega$ 中的某个模式。本工作推广了先前的研究，识别出了针对4小时、6小时、8小时、12小时和24小时CGM曲线的模式集，其中x小时的CGM曲线不必是24小时长度，也不必从午夜开始。先前工作的方法被修改，利用原始工作中相同的6项研究的数据来识别这五个新的模式集。新识别的模式集使用由21项研究组成的数据集（3,455名受试者，289,592天的CGM数据）进行了严格的外部验证。外部验证数据集具有时间和地理上的可迁移性，并解决了用于定义原始模式集的数据集的局限性。
tldr: 该研究将每日CGM曲线的模式匹配方法推广到任意时长和任意起始时间的4至24小时CGM曲线，识别出五个新的模式集，并通过涵盖21项研究、3455名受试者、近29万天数据的大规模数据集进行了严格的外部验证。
en_tdlr: This work generalizes the daily CGM profile motif classification approach to 4-, 6-, 8-, 12-, and 24-hour CGM profiles of arbitrary length and start time, identifying five new motif sets and rigorously validating them externally using data from 21 studies spanning 3,455 subjects and 289,592 days of CGM data.
